signals.name: Casey's General Stores
signals.thesis: Casey's General Stores surging +20.3% to new 52-week high on massive volume after multiple analyst upgrades (Morgan Stanley upgrade to Buy, Stephens reiterate Overweight $900 target, Goldman Sachs $695 target). Technical breakout above all moving averages with volume confirmation. Q3 FY2026 beat drove the catalyst. Convenience store sector is defensive in RISK-OFF, benefiting from consumer staples rotation as SPX drops -1.62% and NASDAQ -1.98%.

signals.name: Murphy USA Inc
signals.thesis: Murphy USA breaking to new 52-week high ($614.13) with +10% surge on strong earnings momentum. Convenience store/gas station operator benefiting from same defensive rotation as CASY. Forward P/E 20.9x reasonable for consistent growth. RSI 71.0 at the limit but below the 72 cap. Volume spike confirms institutional participation. Benefits from lower fuel costs and stable consumer spending on non-discretionary items.

signals.name: Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR
signals.thesis: Consumer Staples ETF breaking above all moving averages (EMA20=83.69, EMA50=83.63, EMA200=82.32) as defensive rotation accelerates. Staples sector outperforming by +2.5% relative to SPX today as risk-off positioning intensifies. MACD bullish crossover confirms trend. VIX at 22.22 and crisis probability at 52.3% make this the textbook defensive allocation. RSI 59.8 provides ample room to run without overextension risk.

signals.name: Health Care Select Sector SPDR
signals.thesis: Healthcare ETF continuing breakout above all moving averages for the second consecutive session. XLV is the sector rotation beneficiary as investors flee tech (-1.98% NASDAQ) into quality healthcare. LLY, UNH, and JNJ all contributing to sector strength. MACD positive (1.69 vs signal 1.10) confirms momentum. Crisis probability at 52.3% makes healthcare the natural defensive hedge. Carried forward from yesterday's scan at lower entry after market pullback.

signals.name: Merck & Co Inc
signals.thesis: Merck breaking above all moving averages ($119.09 > EMA20 $117.38 > EMA50 $116.20 > EMA200 $107.75) with 52-week high at $125.14 within reach. MACD bullish crossover (1.27 > signal 1.00) confirms positive momentum. RSI 55.3 is the most conservative of all picks — maximum room to run. Pharma giant benefits from defensive rotation and dividend yield of 2.85%. Forward P/E 12.5x represents deep value for a mega-cap pharma name with $294B market cap.
